joint_coordinate_units: Native generalized coordinates: rad for revolute joints, m for prismatic joints; corresponding velocities are rad/s and m/s. Per-joint types were not captured by this observer.
scope: Recorded force-readout classification with original2N threshold and original valid samples. Point forces contain normal forces; net forces can contain other contact contributions. All three below threshold does not prove airborne geometry. Position increments and reported velocities are recorded separately; their difference alone does not establish a solver defect.
